summary: The PR addresses the issue of duplicate yields in the post_process method of HashedFilesMixin, which can lead to incorrect statistics and unnecessary processing in collectstatic.

issues.description: The change may introduce behavioral regression if there are valid use cases where yielding the same file multiple times is intended, although the description suggests this is not the case.
There are no additional tests provided to verify that the change does not introduce new issues or regressions, especially regarding the correct handling of nested references and multiple passes.
The change could benefit from a comment explaining why the set `processed_files` is used and how it prevents duplicate yields.
